title: Rav Nachumi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Bava Batra 131a mentions him raising a difficulty against Abaye. Eruvin 71b has a dispute between Rav Nachumi and Rabbah; Hyman thinks that passage should read Rav Rachumi, as in the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim, and describes those disputants as Saboraic rabbis.
We also find Rav Minyumi, son of Rav Nachumi, in Ketubot 69.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Hyman’s Rachumi reading and Saboraic classification concern the Eruvin disputants; they do not assign every Nachumi citation to that period.
The supplied Ketubot locator is סט followed by a comma; no side is supplied, so it is rendered folio 69.

The Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim are contextual expansions of הרא״ש and דק״ס. The Nachumi/Rachumi correction and Saboraic classification are Hyman’s reading of the Eruvin disputants, rather than independent historical findings. מניומי is transliterated Minyumi.
